name: Koneko-chan's Murder Mystery!
source:
You play as Koneko-chan who's hot on the trail of an elusive killer, spend 4 days chatting with characters from Nyan Neko Sugar Girls and decide if vengeance is truly worth it.

[From [url=https://frooty-peblz.itch.io/koneko-chans-murder-mystery]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演小猫酱，热衷于追踪一名难以捉摸的杀手，花4天的时间与Nyan Neko Sugar Girls中的角色聊天，并决定复仇是否真的值得。

[来自[url=https://frooty-peblz.itch.io/koneko-chans-murder-mystery]Itch.io[/url]]
